header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.desc: Open source communication and collaboration platform for construction projects. Chat, file sharing and project coordination — all in one app.

why.title: Why Y-app?
why.desc: Construction projects require constant communication between dozens of parties. Email, WhatsApp and separate tools lead to information loss. Y-app brings all communication together in one place, linked to the project and the BIM model via IFCX.

features.title: Features
features.chat_desc: Real-time chat per project, per discipline or per topic. Messages are searchable and linked to the project.
features.files_desc: Upload and share documents, drawings and IFC models. Automatic version control and connection with OpenAEC Docs.
features.notif_desc: Smart notifications per channel. Choose what you want to follow and how you want to be kept informed.
features.ifcx_desc: Link messages and files to IFCX elements. Communicate directly about specific parts of the model.
features.multi_desc: Available as web app, desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux) and mobile app via Tauri.
features.oss_desc: Full source code available. Host it on your own server for maximum control over data and privacy.
